panel.subtitle: Still, video, and Workshop playlists with schedules and themes

auto_capture.description: Default on. Automatically create a representative still for each video or Wallpaper Engine scene, save it in the managed automatic-stills subfolder, and pair it through Noctalia unless that playlist entry selects a specific still.
auto_capture.label: Automatically create and pair stills

capture_directory.description: Select an existing root for user-owned still wallpapers and manual exports. Wall-in-One does not fall back to another directory or create this root; Wallhaven and automatic-still subfolders remain inactive until it is selected. This may be the same folder as the video wallpaper directory.
capture_directory.label: Image wallpaper directory

cycle_interval_minutes.description: Default delay for newly created playlists. Each playlist stores its own bounded time per wallpaper.
cycle_interval_minutes.label: Default playlist interval (minutes)

cycle_order.description: Default ordering for newly created playlists. Rotate follows entry order; Shuffle uses every entry once before reshuffling.
cycle_order.label: Default playlist order

cycle_start_on_load.description: Resume non-empty saved playlist runs when Wall-in-One loads. One-entry playlists apply once and park.
cycle_start_on_load.label: Start saved playlists on load

retired_compatibility.description: Hidden compatibility declaration for a retired pre-0.7 global setting; per-display engine controls are authoritative.
retired_compatibility.label: Retired Wall-in-One setting

color.description: Theme-token color for this bar placement.
color.label: Color

color_scheme.description: Wallpaper generator used by uncustomized items while adaptive colors are the system default.
color_scheme.label: Wallpaper color scheme

glyph.description: Choose a glyph with Noctalia's native searchable glyph selector.
glyph.label: Glyph

label.description: Text displayed beside the glyph for this placement.
label.label: Label

manual_pair_file.description: Existing image applied by Pair configured still as a standalone static backing. It is not automatically bound to a playlist entry; use Selected still in the entry editor for that. Ordinary images retain their durable path after validation; animated GIFs require optional ffmpeg and become a persistent static PNG, while AVIF validation also requires ffmpeg.
manual_pair_file.label: Manual static backing

motionbgs_cache_minutes.description: Keep bounded search, catalog-page, and detail results locally for this many minutes before fetching their public pages again.
motionbgs_cache_minutes.label: MotionBGS cache duration (minutes)

motionbgs_binary_path.description: Optional absolute path to the separately installed wall-in-one-motionbgs program. Leave blank to detect wall-in-one-motionbgs on PATH. Only MotionBGS browsing is disabled when it is absent or incompatible.
motionbgs_binary_path.label: MotionBGS helper program

motionbgs_max_download_mb.description: Reject a MotionBGS download above this hard size cap before atomically installing it.
motionbgs_max_download_mb.label: MotionBGS maximum download (MiB)

motionbgs_quality.description: Preferred quality for one-click result downloads. The detail card exposes both qualities when the source offers them.
motionbgs_quality.label: MotionBGS preferred quality

motionbgs_result_limit.description: Maximum cards retained from one MotionBGS search or catalog page. The default 48 preserves every card on the site's current 36-item listing pages; details remain lazy.
motionbgs_result_limit.label: MotionBGS result limit

palette_output.description: Optional output connector whose successful entry transitions may update Noctalia's single global palette. A disconnected leader falls back deterministically until it returns; leave empty for latest successful switch wins.
palette_output.label: Global palette leader output

scene_screenshot_delay.description: Capture delay from 1 to 120 frames. Wall-in-One's owned linux-wallpaperengine capture clamps it to upstream's five-frame maximum. This does not affect source-video or preview fallback exports.
scene_screenshot_delay.label: Wallpaper Engine screenshot delay

show_label.description: Show the configured text beside the glyph.
show_label.label: Show label

sync_colors.description: System default for uncustomized library items and new Quick Choice entries. Disable it to keep the current theme; customized items store their own complete policy.
sync_colors.label: Default to adaptive wallpaper colors

use_motionbgs.description: Enable the unofficial bounded MotionBGS public-page browser. Turning it off does not remove the permanent direct-site fallback.
use_motionbgs.label: Use MotionBGS browser

use_wallhaven.description: Enable Wall-in-One's native official-API search, detail, and managed download service. The direct wallhaven.cc link remains available when search is disabled.
use_wallhaven.label: Use native Wallhaven integration

wallhaven_api_key.description: Optional Wallhaven API key sent only in the X-API-Key request header. Public SFW search works without it; Wallhaven requires authentication for NSFW results. This value is stored as a normal Noctalia plugin setting, not an encrypted secret.
wallhaven_api_key.label: Wallhaven API key

video_directory.description: Select an existing root for user-owned video wallpapers. Wall-in-One does not inherit or create this root; MotionBGS storage and its managed download subfolder remain inactive until it is selected. This may be the same folder as the image wallpaper directory; files are sorted by media type.
video_directory.label: Video wallpaper directory

video_frame_second.description: Timestamp, in seconds, used for configured videos and Workshop video projects.
video_frame_second.label: Video still timestamp

video_source.description: Video or animated-image file used by deterministic Export configured video actions. The optional ffmpeg command is required only for video or animated-image extraction.
video_source.label: Configured video source

workshop_directory.description: Optional additional Wallpaper Engine Workshop content/431960 directory.
workshop_directory.label: Additional Workshop directory

workshop_id.description: Numeric Wallpaper Engine Workshop item used when no owned renderer scene is active. Video projects export a frame; scene/web projects use their preview.
workshop_id.label: Workshop ID fallback

widget.storage_error: Wall-in-One storage is invalid. Open its panel through Noctalia IPC to view Diagnostics.
